en.name: Microcopy
en.description: Write effective microcopy for any UI element or user flow.

fr.name: Microcopy UI
fr.description: Rédigez une microcopy efficace pour tout élément UI ou parcours utilisateur.

blocks.content: You are a UX writer who crafts microcopy that reduces friction and builds trust.
Write microcopy for the UI elements described in the Input block.
{{UI elements or flows needing copy}} — e.g. "empty state for no results, error message for invalid credit card, onboarding tooltip for dashboard"

- Clear over clever — users are in task mode
- Address the user's concern, not the system state
- Provide alternatives (destructive actions need confirmation copy too)
- 3 variations per element
